notes.title: Announcing Whiskers and Wizardry!
notes.notes:
I am super proud and excited to announce the next title of Zillo Games: Whiskers and Wizardry!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3326820/

The game follows the exciting world of spellcrafting from Margoq's Lair, but takes a completely different take on it, where there's less focus on finger-twisting and more focus on the tactical aspects of crafting your spells. 

Inspired by Magicraft, Wizard of Legend and Spell Disk, Whiskers and Wizardry aims to provide a gaming experience which heavily encourages experimentation and exploitation of the overwhelming amount of builds and synergies.

notes.notes:
There's been several players asking for keybindings, or reporting that they find the control scheme awkward.

This is adressed in this patch where keybindings have been implemented, for both Mouse, Keyboard and Controllers - you'll find them under Options=>Keybindings. 
Keybindings for the current input device will be shown there. 
To change the device go to Options=>Controls.

On top of that the time window for making the combos has been increased slightly, to make it easier to move and do combos while having an active combo sequence going. 

I hope that this will help give you all a better playing experience - if you are still missing some functionality in regards to controls, please don't hesistate to ask on the forums here or on the [url=https://discord.gg/THEqEZYkTe]Zillo Games Discord Server[/url].

notes.title: Classes, Controls and Compatibility.
notes.notes:
A new update has landed for Margoq's Lair, and it is reflected in the demo as well!

I've received some great feedback from players to improve the game, and it has significantly enhanced it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/c39d4bc2a2c46d6dea1aafedc4bc8d6488b9ddd4.png[/img]

So here's a quick rundown of patch notes. Further down, I will go a bit more in-depth with some of the decisions:

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Controls:[/h3]
[list]
[*] WASD + Controller schemes fully implemented
[*] Option to use auto-aim
[*] Option to auto-pickup items
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Design:[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Implemented an all-new class system.
[*] 7 initial classes, Ember Knight (Demo), Sorcerer (Demo), Blood Lord, Earthcaller, Elementalist, Pyromancer, Viking Warrior.
[*] The Ember Knight is a hybrid character that wields the power of fire to deal damage both in close combat and at range.
[*] The Sorcerer is a fragile but versatile magic caster, dealing a lot of damage from afar.
[*] Players now have a kit of three basic starting spells + one ultimate spell + a basic attack (melee or ranged)
[*] Spell scrolls have combos attached to them instead of spells, meaning you have to learn combos
[*] New death animation for the player
[*] Zkyrix, the final boss, has been updated to be a bit more challenging and interesting
[/list]

[h3]System Compatibility:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Better support for different resolutions: 1280x720, 1920x1080, 2560x1440 (experimental), 3440x1440 (experimental)
[*] Optimized performance for better FPS on lower-end systems
[*] Not taking over native resolution + bigger windowed modes supported, making it easier to tab in and out of the game
[*] Screen shake on/off options
[*] All option states are now saved properly and will carry over to your next game
[/list]

[h1]Details[/h1]
Alright, a couple of these changes have a major impact on the gameplay, so I thought it would be fitting to provide a bit more space. Let's dive into it.

[h3]The new class system[/h3]
The game was initially designed with a class-less approach because I thought it would be awesome to have players design their own build just the way they like it. However, the issue with this has become increasingly apparent due to a little something known as combinatorial math!

Because of the combo system (which is the core mechanic of the game), each newly added spell would require spawning a set of new spells derived from the combination of the new spell with each old spell. This would make the creation of spells grow exponentially. With only 10 basic spells where everything can combo with each other in 2-spell-combos, it would result in 100 spells. Add 3-spell-combos, and it becomes 720 spells! And that's only if we don't allow the same spell in a sequence twice! This would render full coverage of 3-spell-combos out of the question and basically any 4-spell-combos as nothing but a broken dream. It also means that adding much more than 10-12 basic spells would be quite impossible.

Enter the class system. Classes are instead limited to 3 basic spells and an ultimate ability each. Basically, this means that with 3-spell-combos, each class will have access to 15 spells each, which is much more manageable while still providing lots of room for experiments and fun combinations. It also allows for the occasional 4 or even 5-spell-combo. On top of that, it makes it possible to create more interesting Blood Upgrades for the specific combo-spells, meaning lots of build options within the classes themselves. With this approach, it is possible to make 100/15=6-7 new classes with the same amount of work as only the 2-spell-combo 10-ability no-class system.

I hope that you look forward to playing the new classes in the game and like the design choice behind this pretty impactful change of design.

[h3]The control scheme[/h3]
I'll admit it—I've been stubborn! I envisioned the Diablo-like point-and-click control scheme right from the first thoughts of this game and never truly explored other options because that was how it was played in my head. But ever since the very first playtest, I've received feedback that people wanted WASD controls, and controller support requests followed soon after. I've postponed it for too long, and I finally made support and tested with the new control scheme—and IT IS AWESOME! So, thanks to everyone who pointed me in that direction, and sorry for being so stubborn before. The new control scheme makes for a much better feel of the game, and with the controller support as well, it is really coming together great.

[h1]Thanks for reading - I hope you'd try out the changes yourself in the demo![/h1]

notes.title: The Circle of Blood awaits...
notes.notes:
The Circle of Blood awaits within the newest update..

So let's take a deep dive into the newly introduced concept.

Around the lair, players will now encounter randomly generated Circles of Blood. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/ba1deeda5dc4e91c41803b5bdc5f15f4b01dfab5.png[/img]  
These circles are used to progress the character and make interesting builds.
When first clicking on a Circle of Blood, the player collects 2 "Blood Points". Blood Points can be used to purchase upgrades that makes the player more powerful. 

You will find general perk upgrades such as "Automedic", which makes the player heal passively for a percentage of their maximum health every 5 seconds when out of combat. 

You can also find upgrades for the abilities or combos that you have available. For instance, the "Meteorist", which gives a chance to land another Meteor at the same spot, if the first one landed on at least 2 enemies. Oh, and by the way - this can trigger another... and another one... So you are in for a Meteoric treat! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/0e21aee859846b22c4fd7c0fd968ec92c79a1aea.png[/img]

[h1]Diversifying builds[/h1]
The new Circle of Blood system, ensures even more replayability and increases the amount of different builds available to the players to an overwhelming extend.

Here's [i]some[/i] of the new upgrades you can gain from the Circle of Blood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/9adee568df39d8fab7fa4d137596361e56d92c60.png[/img] 

Some of the interesting builds I've tried to test out were:

[list]
[*] Meteorist X 4 + Glass Cannon X 3 + Living on the Edge X 3: This makes you a rolling ball of death. Those damage numbers are insane, but you are also rendered extremely fragile. Hint: find a group of bats with a few elites in between, make sure you are under 30% health and then wind up a Meteor by using Fireball, Stomp, Fireball. This could easily deal more than 230 damage to each bat on impact, probably killing all of them in one go.
[*] Souleater X 5 + Improved Health Potion X 3 + Magical Resistance X 3: This makes you quite tanky, throw in some Longevity upgrades as well to make sure that shield keeps up, and you will fear nobody. 
[*] Blood Rush X 3 + Energized X 5 : This makes you have a ton of energy to use on abilities. Combine with your favorite spell upgrades, and you can deal quite some damage while keeping up the pace.
[/list]

notes.title: Polishing update - Margoq's Lair demo version 1.5 live
notes.notes:
This update has quite a few changes. The changes are primarily based on feedback from players and while there isn't any one big change, the game feel much more polished now.

Changes include:
[list]
[*] Summary version of pick-profile screen, to give an overview and hide away details.
[*] Dropped [i]souls [/i]are attracted to players when close by, thus easier to pick up.
[*] [i]Souls [/i]heal for a small amount of health, giving another opportunity than just [i]potions [/i]to heal.
[*] The death screen is improved making the player aware that they've been killed before popping open a window.
[*] Players cannot die from a single large blow if they are above 20% health - this is implemented to avoid frustrating player deaths that feels unfair.
[*] Elites' and super-elites' [i]berserker [/i]mode now has a 1 second cast time, and the creature gets a bit bigger to ensure players sees it.
[*] Bats can't go into [i]berserker [/i] mode anymore.
[*] Font is changed throughout the game, to give a more coherent player experience.
[*] [i]Amulet [/i]abilities have reduced cooldown
[*] Items has gained a [i]Power[/i] attribute, which gives a quick summary of the power of the item across other stats. 
[*] New items in the inventory now have values that compare their stats to the equipped item's stats.
[*] Gathered [i]souls[/i] are now hidden form the main UI and shown in the inventory instead.
[*] Quest UI is now hidden in tutorial level.
[*] [i]Dash [/i]is now not available before needed in tutorial.
[*] Grayed out background when popups are open.
[*] The name of dropped items are now invisible before mouseover. Instead dropped items of all qualities has a small light added to them, in order to ensure players still see them.
[*] Players are now notified when quests are completed.
[*] [i]Meteors [/i]from the [i]Firestorm [/i]curse now deals less damage.
[*] [i]Fireballs [/i]now dies when going off screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Stat system revised in Margoq's Lair Demo V1.4
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Margoq's Lair Demo version 1.4 is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/d907f699ade5c60d6f98a69b99096b3c26369172.png[/img]

The demo's primary focus has been on the new stat system and balancing around it. The following changes has been implemented:

[list]
[*] Accuracy now affects Hit Chance, as well as Critical Strike Chance.
[*] Strength now affects Armor and Attack Power.
[*] Wisdom now affects Magic Resistance and Magic Power.
[*] Physical Damage stat is removed, and replaced with the Attack Power stat. 
[*] Attack Power affects melee attacks and all physical damage abilities.
[*] Weapons now has a direct Attack Power modifier on top of any primary stats. This attack power will also influence the base attacks of melee attacks and certain physical abilities that naturally depend on weapons (like Cleave).
[*] Magic Power affects all magical abilities.
[*] Magic Resistance is a flat reduction % to incoming magical damage. Both the player and the enemies has this.
[*] Armor is a flat reduction % to incoming physical damage. Both the player and the enemies has this.
[*] Hit chance affects both physical and magical abilities. At a later point, it will be possible to get a perk to turn missed attacks into glancing blows.
[*] UI is updated to include more information about abilities, how much damage they give and what type of damage they do.
[*] Base damage of abilities will increase by each level on top of any stat modifications.
[*] All stats has been adjusted to higher numbers, making it %-based improvements/reductions more meaningful. 
[*] Temporary abilities and effects can now improve/reduce the secondary stats, instead of the primary stats. For instance the "Crippling Cleave", made with the Shield + Cleave Combo now reduces affected enemies' Attack Power by 10% for 10 seconds.
[/list]

All in all the stat system is much more flexible now, and it enables many interesting options for items, abilities, effects etc. 

At the same time information about the abilities is also much more transparent to the player, such that they can make more meaningful choices when building their character. It should all in all give a much more interesting player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/360d04cf331f6687144ac4ed801a6eb0efeb7b80.png[/img]

notes.title: Margoq's Lair at the Scream Fest and Version 1.3 live!
notes.notes:
Margoq's Lair entered the Scream Fest, hopefully giving a lot of new people the opportunity to see the horrific lair of Margoq at first hand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/408e35ca17a86f1e8c7cecff228dc37a97c9ec41.png[/img]

With it, the demo is now also updated with some new nice major features!

[list]
[*] A minimap is added to the UI, giving info about quest objectives and giving players a better overview of the map
[*] The meteor ability has been enhanced quite a lot visually as well as functionally! Try out the meteor today, by casting Fireball + Stomp + Fireball. It leaves a burning area after landing that burns enemies that enters it
[*] Improved pyroblast now also burns the enemy over 2 seconds, dealing that extra damage to the already injured enemies.
[*] Margoq now only curses the floors from the 2nd floor onward. While the curse mechanic is a nice addition to the game, it also becomes a bit overwhelming to grasp right on the first level - thus the first level is free of curses now.
[*] A new curse has become available to Margoq! He can now curse the floor with Firestorm, casting Meteors every now and then to try and hit the player. 
[*] Bugfix where amulets and rings would not adjust the stats when equipped, but still take away the stats when unequipped.
[/list]

Looking forward to see you all play the new and very improved version of Margoq's Lair!

notes.title: Margoq's Lair Demo Version 1.2.1 now live!
notes.notes:
After some feedback from the latest patch, a couple of bugs have been found and eliminated.
One where the tutorial could proceed without the player following the guide and one where popups of the UI was shown outside the screen. These have been fixed in this update.

On top of that there's been made changes to the way torchlights work is rendered. For some context; the torchlights have from the beginning been something that everyone playing the game or viewing a trailer has commented, either they loved it or they hated it. I've been a bit hesitant with changing it, because so many people also like it and I think that they provide a nice atmosphere. However, after some thoughts and trying out different things, I've made some changes that hopefully makes more people like them. They are now less intense in the lights, but still provides some atmosphere. Also the radius has been made a bit wider, while the intensity drop per distance is set up, meaning that we get a smoother transition between lighted and non-lighted areas and the light feels less cut off.
Hopefully this change will make the lights feel more natural and less eye catching, while still providing some atmosphere to Margoq's Lair.

I might still adjust the values a bit, to make it feel just right. Let me know what you think!

A screenshot of the changes can be seen here: 
Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/9b6a9e2551da2885587f179664409b4c20657e1a.png[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/e5ce78d23a461bf41c795e98c504ec4887864974.png[/img]


The tutorial was also a bit lengthy and texty. I've changed it a bit, so that it is shorter, while still going through the neccessary steps for people to understand the game.

I hope that the changes fit you well. Feedback always welcomed!

Best regards,

Mathias Zillo Christiansen
Zillo Games

notes.title: Margoq's Lair Demo V1.2.0 now live
notes.notes:
[h2]Summary[/h2]
This update includes:

[list]
[*] A brand new tutorial level, where Harald himself guides you through the initial steps of the game. 
[*] The difficulty has been adjusted once more, as data still shows that it is a bit too difficult for a demo.
[*] Reduced amount of levels to 4 - 3 normal levels and a boss level.
[*] Polished some more UI 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/8fae00f7ae7ee4812b9534c466bbec60be3b6e5c.png[/img]

[h2]Looking to extend demo playtime[/h2]
In general it is going quite well with the demo and a lot of people seems pleased as they come back multiple times to play it, however, there is also a significant amount of people that quit really early. The data seems to indicate that they fail the first level rather quickly (in less than 1 minute). Then try again and fail again. At the same time the demo still haven't been beaten by more than a handful of people.

In my opinion this indicates two things:

[list]
[*] The difficulty in general is still a bit too high. Most people don't make it past 2nd level, and many already fails on the first one. Also, not enough players get to complete the demo. 
[*] The game is not intuitive enough to play, so people die because it's not easily understood how to play.
[/list]

Therefore I focused on making a tutorial, which can hopefully help to bring down the amount of people struggeling to complete level 1, I reduced the length of the demo by 1 level to make more people complete it, and I lowered the Normal difficulty a little bit further.

I monitor the data in the coming days and see if this helped or futher adjustments needs to be done.

Thanks for playing the demo and please wishlist today.

Best regards,

Mathias Zillo Christiansen
Zillo Games

notes.title: UI/UX Overhaul - Demo V1.1.0 now up!
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo V1.1.0 live now![/h1]
Download the latest demo for free to try out the new changes to Margoq's Lair!

Remember that it is still just a demo, so while you can get a nice sense of how the game plays and the overall features are more or less all shown in the demo, a lot of depth and replayability value will be saved for the actual release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/b4be522317feb938bdc535f4c3b331401bbeafe9.png[/img]

I do hope that you enjoy the demo - and please leave any and all feedback or bug reports in the a thread in the community or in the discord server: https://discord.gg/BuzeGND878 . 

[h2]UI/UX Overhaul[/h2]
The major new feature is the UI/UX overhaul. The UI now matches the graphical style of the game alot better, plus it is now easier to navigate the inventory system, which is now up to par with other games in the genre. 

The inventory space has been increased as well, so you don't need to throw items out of it all the time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/75dc3b8b9ad78a68e973ba8f0c9bf9a40f23240b.png[/img]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/88103786ce193c400fc064db5bedb4d26e3d9c36.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo v1.0.1 Released
notes.notes:
The UI has been the last bastion of placeholders and now the work has begun making an overhaul to it. The game has been suffering from the UI, but the improvements done now is the first steps to give the UI the right vibe, making it worthy of Margoq's Lair.

On top of that players seems to have had a difficult time in the first levels of the demo, therefore the difficulty has been adjusted to make it a bit easier to get into, while the final boss of the demo has seen a slight increase in difficulty. To further make the first levels easier, it is planned to make a tutorial level after the current UI overhaul. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44680941/c2122b958894e71dbf07f42c404ef4b555d6827e.png[/img]
